note: Continuous road-world kit for the Grand Highway. The environment is fixed; tiles, hotel miniatures, stamps, cars, and gates share one depth coordinate and move together. All coordinates are natural pixels on the 852 x 1515 environment image.

environment.role: fixed scenic layer only; it contains no tile, pad, hotel, stamp, car, or gate

tile.role: single rich porcelain material reused for every stay tile

depthAxis.meaning: z=0 is the horizon; z=1 is the foreground rim. A new stay advances every moving world item by deltaPerStay toward the foreground.

stays.unit: one stay per tile; show number of nights inside the stamp

hotelPads.rule: Each stayed tile owns one hotel pad on the alternating roadside. The pad and hotel use the same z as their tile and travel by the same deltaPerStay.

gate.rule: One road-spanning transparent gate sits at the boundary immediately ahead of the current tile. Its legs land outside the lane on the shoulders.
gate.travel: Gate, tile, hotel pad, stamp, and car all advance by deltaPerStay in the same transition. Do not animate a gate against a stationary tile.

transition.rule: Use interpolated z positions for every moving item. Recycle an item only after it crosses z=1.20; spawn the next future tile at z=0.05.
